name: switched-burst-release
title: DC/DC light load: current-driven burst
purpose: Bus PRECHARGED to 406 V, 10 kΩ load (light load, about 16 W), BUSREG entered from IDLE at t = 0. Current-driven burst (ADR 0003): the converter starts with every PWM period skipped; once the bus falls below the reference, the skip count follows the current demand. Checks the bus stays within ±5 % and leg 2 stays off.
